scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide view of a city street with a person riding a bicycle on the left side of the road and another person crossing the street in front of a large building on the right side. The sky is clear and blue with a few clouds in the distance. The street has a red bike lane on the left side with white markings and a yellow traffic signal on the right side. There are several buildings lining the street, including a large tan building with many windows and balconies on the right side. A tree line runs along the left side of the street with some bare trees and a few evergreen trees. The ground is made of concrete with a red stripe running down the middle of the street. The sidewalk is made of gray concrete with a curb separating it from the street. The sun is shining brightly casting shadows on the ground.
